prompt: Simulate seeded dice rolls: sum the results of rolling a six-sided die a given number of times using new java.util.Random(seed). Complete the rollSum method in the starter file.
explanation: java.util.Random produces a deterministic sequence of pseudo-random numbers: the same seed always yields the same sequence, which is why the tests can hard-code expected sums. nextInt(6) returns a value from 0 to 5, so adding 1 turns it into a die roll from 1 to 6. Creating the Random once outside the loop is essential; re-seeding inside the loop would repeat the same roll forever.
hints: Create the Random exactly once, before the loop: java.util.Random random = new java.util.Random(seed);
nextInt(6) gives 0..5, so each roll is random.nextInt(6) + 1.
Accumulate the rolls in an int sum inside a for loop that runs `times` iterations, then return the sum.
